_about: Inputs from the third check of the pure-app gate (round 2 reverify): emergencies and hazards told only in app words ("app froze get me out", "it shut on me", "la app se cerro y el no sale", "otis there was a crash"), word-by-word attacks on the vocabulary, realistic crew messages, and report-flow inputs; plus attacks of my own on what is left of the vocabulary after it was shrunk.

urgent: must get the 911 banner and the safety answer. hazard: must get the safety answer, never a support path. app: real app complaints (a support path is hoped for, never required). flows: [first message, step, what is typed, E|H|A]. failing: the inputs that failed before this round.

Left out on purpose (low): "who should i contact" still shows "Who to contact for help" (that entry says to call 911 first and ask a supervisor, and now carries the 911 line), and is still taken as the description at the describe step; "leak@dock" at the email step reads as a mistyped email. "otis que hago" is kept off every support path but does not turn on the banner.
